title: Two-on-Two King of the Court
description: Winning pairs stay on the court to face a new challenger pair, a simple format that keeps every game competitive and meaningful.

content.objective: Compete meaningfully in every game since winners keep playing and losers must earn their way back on.
content.setup: Pairs of two line up to challenge the current pair on the court, playing to a short target score.
instructions: The current pair on the court plays the next challenging pair to a target score, such as five points.
The winning pair stays on the court; the losing pair rotates to the back of the line.
Play continues continuously with no long breaks between games.
Track which pair wins the most consecutive games.
coachingPoints: Compete at full effort every single game, since winning keeps you on the court.
Communicate with your partner between possessions.
Play smart, efficient basketball to win quickly and keep your spot.
commonMistakes: Playing carelessly in games that feel less important.
Arguing over calls instead of playing through and resetting quickly.
Losing composure after a bad result instead of resetting for the next one.
content.safety: Keep contact controlled; call fouls to maintain a fair and safe pace.
